cases.sentence: Бросив деньги в храме, ___ ушел и повесился
cases.translation: Throwing down the money in the temple, Judas went away and hanged himself.
cases.explain: Иуда is the subject of ушел (went away) — nominative.

cases.sentence: он взял ___, вымыл руки перед всем народом и сказал
cases.translation: He took some water, washed his hands before the crowd and said...
cases.explain: Partitive genitive after взял (took some) → воды.

cases.sentence: Иосиф пошел к ___ и попросил тело Иисуса.
cases.translation: Joseph went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to, toward) takes the dative → Пилату.

cases.sentence: Иосиф взял его, обернул чистым льняным полотном и положил в свою новую ___, которая была вырублена в скале
cases.translation: Joseph took him, wrapped him in clean linen cloth, and laid him in his own new tomb, which had been cut out of the rock.
cases.explain: «Положил в» (placed into) expresses motion into a place, so the noun takes the accusative → гробницу.

cases.sentence: Иосиф взял его, обернул чистым льняным ___ и положил в свою новую гробницу
cases.translation: Joseph took him, wrapped him in clean linen cloth, and laid him in his own new tomb.
cases.explain: Обернул (чем?) — the material used to wrap something is expressed by the instrumental → полотном.

cases.sentence: когда Пилат сидел в судейском ___, его жена послала сказать ему
cases.translation: While Pilate was sitting in the judgment seat, his wife sent word to him.
cases.explain: В showing location (not motion) takes the prepositional → кресле.

reading.ru: Рано утром все первосвященники и старейшины народа вынесли Иисусу смертный приговор.
reading.question: What did the religious leaders decide early in the morning?
reading.explain: Early in the morning the chief priests and elders pronounced the death sentence on Jesus.

reading.ru: «Я согрешил», — сказал он, — «я предал на смерть невинного человека».
reading.question: What did Judas confess after seeing Jesus condemned?
options: That he had betrayed an innocent man
That the priests had lied to him
reading.correct: That he had betrayed an innocent man
reading.explain: Judas said, “I have sinned, I have betrayed an innocent man to death.”

reading.ru: Бросив деньги в храме, Иуда ушел и повесился
reading.question: What did Judas do after throwing down the silver in the temple?
options: He went away and hanged himself
He returned the money to Pilate
reading.correct: He went away and hanged himself
reading.explain: After throwing the money down in the temple, Judas went away and hanged himself.

reading.ru: И, посоветовавшись, они решили купить на них поле горшечника и использовать его под кладбище для чужеземцев.
reading.question: What did the chief priests do with the returned silver?
options: They bought a potter's field to bury foreigners
They gave it to the poor
They put it into the temple treasury
reading.correct: They bought a potter's field to bury foreigners
reading.explain: They used the silver to buy the potter's field as a burial place for foreigners.

reading.ru: «Ты царь Иудеев?» «Ты сам так говоришь», — отвечал Иисус.
reading.question: How did Jesus answer Pilate's question about being King of the Jews?
options: He refused to answer at all
"Yes, I am the king of all nations"
reading.explain: When asked if he was the King of the Jews, Jesus answered, “You say so.”

reading.ru: В то время под стражей находился известный узник по имени Варава.
reading.question: Who was Barabbas?
options: A notorious prisoner held in custody
reading.correct: A notorious prisoner held in custody
reading.explain: Barabbas was a well-known prisoner being held in custody at the time.

reading.ru: «Не делай ничего этому праведнику, я сильно страдала сегодня во сне из-за него».
reading.question: What warning did Pilate's wife send him?
options: To have nothing to do with that righteous man because of a dream
reading.correct: To have nothing to do with that righteous man because of a dream
reading.explain: Pilate's wife warned him because she had suffered much in a dream because of Jesus.

reading.ru: Когда Пилат увидел, что ничего не может сделать, и что волнение в народе лишь нарастает, он взял воды, вымыл руки перед всем народом
reading.question: What did Pilate do when he saw the crowd's unrest growing?
options: He washed his hands before the crowd
He called the guards to disperse the crowd
reading.correct: He washed his hands before the crowd
reading.explain: Seeing that nothing was working and the crowd's unrest was growing, Pilate washed his hands before them.

reading.ru: Исплетя венок из терновника, надели ему на голову, дали ему в правую руку трость и стали насмехаться над ним
reading.question: How did the soldiers mock Jesus?
options: They put a crown of thorns on him and a staff in his hand
They gave him royal robes and a throne
They forced him to carry a sword
reading.correct: They put a crown of thorns on him and a staff in his hand
reading.explain: They wove a crown of thorns and placed it on his head, and put a staff in his right hand.

reading.ru: Когда они выходили, им повстречался человек из Кирены по имени Симон, и солдаты заставили его нести крест.
reading.question: Who was forced to carry Jesus' cross?
reading.explain: The soldiers made Simon of Cyrene carry the cross.

reading.ru: Когда они пришли на место, называемое Голгофа, что означает «лобное место», они дали ему вино, смешанное с желчью.
reading.question: What did they offer Jesus at Golgotha before crucifying him?
reading.explain: At Golgotha they gave Jesus wine mixed with gall.

reading.ru: Около девятого часа Иисус громко крикнул, «Эли, Эли, лэма савахтани!» Что значит «Боже мой, Боже мой, почему ты меня оставил?»
reading.question: What did Jesus cry out around the ninth hour?
options: "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"
"Into your hands I commit my spirit"
reading.correct: "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"
reading.explain: Jesus cried out, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani,” meaning “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

reading.ru: И тут завеса храма разорвалась надвое сверху донизу. Затряслась земля и раскололись скалы.
reading.question: What happened at the moment Jesus died?
options: The temple curtain tore in two and the earth shook
reading.correct: The temple curtain tore in two and the earth shook
reading.explain: At Jesus' death the temple curtain tore in two and the earth shook, splitting the rocks.

reading.ru: Иосиф взял его, обернул чистым льняным полотном и положил в свою новую гробницу, которая была вырублена в скале.
reading.question: What did Joseph of Arimathea do with Jesus' body?
options: He wrapped it in linen and laid it in his own new tomb
He cremated it according to custom
He left it on the cross
He gave it to the disciples to bury
reading.correct: He wrapped it in linen and laid it in his own new tomb
reading.explain: Joseph wrapped the body in clean linen and placed it in his own new tomb cut out of the rock.
